groups.sentence: Students confirm what is acceptable before using AI tools for resumes, cover letters, and interviewing.
Students may use AI to prepare for careers, such as exploring occupations and skillsets, resumes, cover letters, and job interviews.
Students may use AI for everyday personal tasks, such as deciphering email tone, creating recipes, and planning meals.
Students personalize and customize their application materials to stand out.
Application reviewers who suspect or can tell AI was used may count it against the application.
Everyone may make occasional personal use of university AI resources if it does not interfere with university business use.
Generative AI can be a good starting point for research.
